PART III — LANDS
No. 1940/27 – FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 13, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No. : T/TH/DS/LA/159. Land Ministry Reference No. : 3-4/5/2013/HW/37.

I, hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the Land or servitude to be acquired: - The allotment of land in total extent about 4.3836 Hectares which is marked for 185 lots, depicted in FTP 6, Sheet No. 428, 429 and Tri/TMP/2014/147 prepared by the Surveyor General, Trincomalee, situated in the Thambalagamam, Puthukudiyiruppu, Pokkuruni, Koviladi Grama Niladari Divisions, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Thambalagamam, in Tricomalee, Eastern Province and bounded as follows:
